sentences.en: Occupational stability is of great concern to recently graduated students.
sentences.zh: 最近毕业的学生非常关心职业稳定性。

sentences.en: The tail at the rear of the plane provides stability.
sentences.zh: 飞机尾部的尾巴提供稳定性。

sentences.en: Layla was looking at Fadil for financial gains and stability.
sentences.zh: 莱拉看中法迪尔的是经济上的收益和稳定。

senses.zh: 稳定性，稳固；稳定状态，平衡；坚固性，牢固性；（政治、经济等的）稳定，安定
